Data.title: Government Operating Revenue, Monthly
Data.footnote: Figures may not add up due to rounding.

row.footnote: Operating Revenue refers to receipts credited to the Consolidated Revenue Account and Development Fund Account, excluding investment and interest income, capital receipts, investment adjustments and receipts related to the Significant Infrastructure Government Loan Act 2021.

A non-resident is liable to pay income tax on Singapore-sourced income.  Under the law, when payment of a specified nature (e.g. royalty, interest, etc.) is made to a non-resident company or individual, the payer must withhold a percentage of that payment and pay the amount withheld to IRAS.  The amount withheld is the Withholding Tax.

Estate Duty refers to a tax on the total market value of a person's assets (cash and non-cash) at the date of his or her death.  Estate Duty does not apply to a person who dies on or after 15 February 2008, although there are still some collections from the estates of people who had passed away earlier
